# Metadata fixture provenance

`srgb.icc` was generated with Pillow 12.3.0 / LittleCMS 2.19 using
`ImageCms.ImageCmsProfile(ImageCms.createProfile("sRGB")).tobytes()`.
It is retained unchanged for reproducible header/transport tests; the standard
built-in profile's copyright tag permits free use. Its SHA-256 is
`1e37c7fb0e8db29f32347d7fc118d085f91088f49e0b106bf3448d952a994523`.
Regeneration of the external metadata gate reuses this saved file.

`ycck-8.jpg` and `ycck-12.jpg` are generated by this crate's
`examples/encode_fixtures.rs`: the `p8-q90-ycck-444-p0-b1` and
`p12-q90-ycck-444-p0-b1` cases. They use deterministic synthetic encoded
component samples, not third-party artwork. They validate Adobe transform 2
metadata handling; reference pixel/color checks are tracked separately.
